_comment: Smart punctuation out of code before a message is sent or saved (2026-10-06): iOS's TextField always curls ' and " into ‘ ’ “ ” and turns -- into — (and - into –), and Japanese keyboards on Android type ’ ” for ' ". Inside inline code spans (`…`, ``…``) and closed fenced blocks — found as the renderer finds them — ‘ ’ → ', “ ” → ", — → --, – → -; text outside code, an unclosed backtick and an unclosed fence stay as typed. Read by MessageBodyView.swift BodyTokenizer.straightenCode and BodyTokenizer.kt straightenCode (desktop: browsers do not substitute).
